description_en: Queries the sensitivity levels of a classification template
description_zh: 获取分类分级模板对应的敏感序列列表
name: ListSensitivityLevel

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html in the topic "Manage DMS tenants."
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to query the ID of the classification template
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the classification template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to query the type of the classification template.

Valid values:

USER_DEFINE: a custom template.
INNER: a built-in template
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板类型。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_type
